text: The Titanic is sinking. And I am still on board.
My part is made up. Everything around me is true.
The lifeboats are gone. About 1,500 of us are left.
Distress rockets burst over the ship, one after another.
The bow goes under. The sea comes up the deck.
At 2:20 in the morning, the Titanic is gone.
I swim for an overturned lifeboat. About thirty men cling to it.
At about four, a ship arrives: the Carpathia.
She saves about 700 people. About 1,500 are lost.
I survived the Titanic. Most did not.
